'''Stefan Rahmstorf''' (born 22 February 1960) is a German [[oceanographer]] and [[climatologist]]. Since 2000, he has been a Professor of Physics of the Oceans at [[University of Potsdam|Potsdam University]]. He studied physical oceanography at [[Bangor University]] and received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in [[oceanography]] from [[Victoria University of Wellington]] (1990). His work focuses on the role of [[ocean current]]s in [[climate change]].<ref name="cv">[http://www.pik-potsdam.de/~stefan/cv.html Stefan Rahmstorf | Curriculum Vitae]</ref> He was one of the lead authors of the [[IPCC Fourth Assessment Report]].<ref name=cv/>

== Public role ==
Rahmstorf is a co-founder of the blog ''[[RealClimate]]'', which has been described by ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' as one of the top-5 science blogs in 2006,<ref name="2006_Nature">{{cite journal |title=Top five science blogs |journal=[[Nature (journal)|Nature]] |year=2006 |volume=442 |pmid=16823420 |issue=9 |doi= 10.1038/442009a |page=9 |bibcode = 2006Natur.442....9. |doi-access=free}}</ref> and included among the 15 best environmental websites by ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' in 2008.<ref name=time-2008>{{cite news|last=Roston|first=Eric|title=RealClimate|url=http://www.time.com/time/specials/2007/article/0,28804,1730759_1731034_1732032,00.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080421181440/http://www.time.com/time/specials/2007/article/0,28804,1730759_1731034_1732032,00.html|archive-date=21 April 2008|access-date=8 January 2012|newspaper=[[Time (magazine)|Time]]|date=17 April 2008}}</ref> He also co-founded the German blog ''KlimaLounge''.<ref name=kl>{{cite web|title=KlimaLounge - Über das Blog|url=http://www.scilogs.de/wblogs/blog/klimalounge/content/about|publisher=SciLogs|access-date=8 January 2012}}</ref> ''KlimaLounge'' won the 3rd prize of the science blog award of 2013.<ref>''[http://wissenschaftkommuniziert.wordpress.com/2014/01/02/prosit-2014-der-wissenschafts-blog-des-jahres-2013-ist-gewahlt/ Wissenschaft kommuniziert | Prosit 2014 – Der Wissenschafts-Blog des Jahres 2013 ist gewählt]'', 2. Januar 2014</ref> He is a frequent contributor of articles on climate and climate change/[[global warming]] in the popular press, some of which are internationally syndicated via [[Project Syndicate]].<ref name=pj>{{cite web|title=Project Syndicate - Author's Bio|date=11 November 2013 |url=http://www.project-syndicate.org/columnist/stefan-rahmstorf|publisher=[[Project Syndicate]]|access-date=8 January 2014}}</ref> He writes a regular column in the German environmental magazine ''Zeo2'',<ref name=zeo2>{{cite web|title=Zeo2 - Stefan Rahmstorf|url=http://www.zeozwei.de/?s=rahmstorf|access-date=8 January 2012|archive-date=17 May 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130517074307/http://www.zeozwei.de/?s=rahmstorf}}</ref> and has published the children's science book ''Wolken, Wind und Wetter'' (''Clouds, Wind, and Weather'') on weather and climate.<ref>{{cite web|last=Rahmstorf|first=Stefan|title=Buchtipp: Wolken, Wind & Wetter|url=http://www.pik-potsdam.de/~stefan/kinderuni.html|access-date=8 January 2012}}</ref><ref name=www-hr>{{cite news|title=Stefan Rahmstorf "Wolken, Wind und Wetter" - Buchmesse 2011|url=http://www.hr-online.de/website/specials/buchmesse2011/index.jsp?rubrik=67983&key=standard_rezension_42618712|archive-url=https://archive.today/20111003015840/http://www.hr-online.de/website/specials/buchmesse2011/index.jsp?rubrik=67983&key=standard_rezension_42618712|archive-date=3 October 2011|access-date=8 January 2012|newspaper=[[Hessischer Rundfunk]]|date=29 September 2011}}</ref> The book was selected as ''Environmental Book of the Month'' for January 2012 by the ''Deutsche Umweltstiftung''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Umweltbuch des Monats Januar 2012: "Wolken, Wind & Wetter"|url=http://www.deutscheumweltstiftung.de/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=36&Itemid=215|publisher=Deutsche Umweltstiftung|access-date=13 January 2012}}</ref> In addition, it was later voted ''Environmental Book of the Year 2012''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Umweltbuch des Jahres 2012: "Wolken, Wind & Wetter"|url=http://www.deutscheumweltstiftung.de/index.php/pressearchiv/377-umweltbuch-des-jahres-2012-qwolken-wind-a-wetterq|archive-url=https://archive.today/20140110122819/http://www.deutscheumweltstiftung.de/index.php/pressearchiv/377-umweltbuch-des-jahres-2012-qwolken-wind-a-wetterq|archive-date=10 January 2014|publisher=Deutsche Umweltstiftung|access-date=10 January 2014}}</ref>

== Work ==
The [[University of Flensburg]] found that among all climate scientists from Germany, Rahmstorf published the largest number of studies which ranked amongst the most-cited in the scientific literature during the years 1994–2013.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-flensburg.de/fileadmin/content/zentren/nec/dokumente/downloads/datendokumentation-exzellente-deutsche-klimaforschung-spektrum-online-ma-rz-2014.pdf|author=Bernd Sommer|publisher=Universität Flensburg|date=13 March 2014|title=Die zehn meistzitierten Klimastudien aus Deutschland der Jahre 1994-2013|access-date=7 April 2016|archive-date=15 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220815124211/https://www.uni-flensburg.de/fileadmin/content/zentren/nec/dokumente/downloads/datendokumentation-exzellente-deutsche-klimaforschung-spektrum-online-ma-rz-2014.pdf}}</ref> Rahmstorf was a member of the German [[Wissenschaftlicher Beirat der Bundesregierung Globale Umweltveränderungen|Advisory Council on Global Change]] (WBGU) from 2004 till 2013.<ref>{{cite news|title=WBGU Advisory Council on Global Change|url=http://www.wbgu.de/en/council-members/2013-2016/|access-date=10 January 2014|archive-date=15 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180215134603/http://www.wbgu.de/en/council-members/2013-2016/}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
* [https://www.egu.eu/awards-medals/alfred-wegener/ Alfred Wegener Medal], 2024, awarded by the European Geosciences Union ''to honour a scientist who has achieved exceptional international standing in atmospheric, hydrological or ocean sciences''
*''Climate Communication Prize'' of the American Geophysical Union (2017).<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://eos.org/agu-news/2017-agu-union-medal-award-and-prize-recipients-announced|title=2017 AGU Union Medal, Award, and Prize Recipients Announced|year=2017|author=AGU}}</ref>
*[[American Geophysical Union|Fellow of the American Geophysical Union]] (2010)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pik-potsdam.de/news/in-short/archive/2010/stefan-rahmstorf-elected-fellow-of-the-american-geophysical-union?set_language=en|title=Stefan Rahmstorf elected Fellow of the American Geophysical Union|date=17 February 2010|author=PIK|access-date=13 May 2015|archive-date=2 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171202102238/https://www.pik-potsdam.de/news/in-short/archive/2010/stefan-rahmstorf-elected-fellow-of-the-american-geophysical-union?set_language=en}}</ref>
*Along with other authors of the IPCC AR4 report, he was honored by the award of the [[2007 Nobel Peace Prize]] to the IPCC, shared with [[Al Gore]].<ref name="Schiermeier Tollefson 2007">{{cite journal | last1=Schiermeier | first1=Quirin | last2=Tollefson | first2=Jeff | title=a Nobel cause | journal=Nature News | date=12 October 2007 | url=http://www.nature.com/news/2007/071012/full/news.2007.164.html | doi=10.1038/news.2007.164 | access-date=20 May 2015| url-access=subscription }}</ref>
*Honorary Fellow of the [[University of Wales]] (2007)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Twya6HcGmVY |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211213/Twya6HcGmVY |archive-date=2021-12-13 |url-status=live|title=Rahmstorf speech, University of Wales award ceremony|date=19 July 2007|publisher=YouTube}}{{cbignore}}</ref>
*German Environmental Media Award (''Deutscher Umweltmedienpreis''), for his work on scientific accurate reporting anthropogenic climate change and impacts (2007)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.wbgu.de/en/press-appointments/press-releases/2007-12-10-v2-press-release/|title=German Environmental Aid 2007 media award goes to Stefan Rahmstorf|date=10 December 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150518080025/http://www.wbgu.de/en/press-appointments/press-releases/2007-12-10-v2-press-release/|archive-date=18 May 2015}}</ref>
*''Centennial Fellowship Award'' from the [[James S. McDonnell Foundation]], research grant of $1 million (1999)<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.jsmf.org/grants/1999033/|title=Currents of Change|year=1999|author=James S. McDonnell Foundation}}</ref>
